facts.fact: The document, published by NBS and OCGS in December 2021 with a ministerial foreword, presents the Tanzania Statistical Master Plan Phase Two (TSMP II) as the country's second National Strategy for Development of Statistics, in force for 2022/23 to 2026/27; it gives no adoption date, so as_of is its publication date.
facts.system: Tanzania Statistical Master Plan Phase Two (TSMP II)

facts.fact: The document states TSMP I (2011/12 to 2017/18) was reviewed in 2019 and that its evaluation reports informed the design of TSMP II; the evaluation covers TSMP I, the predecessor strategy, and no TSMP II evaluation is reported as done (mid-term and end-term evaluations are only planned).
